description: This file defines a typed backend client for SpendSense, providing methods to interact with various API endpoints such as analytics, alerts, and transactions. It includes JSDoc typedefs for data structures, utility functions for query string creation, and a factory function to instantiate the client based on environment configuration.

methods.name: toQuery
methods.description: Creates a URL query string from optional parameters, filtering out null or empty values.

methods.name: pickApiBaseOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL from environment variables or returns null if not set.

methods.name: getBackendClient
methods.description: Returns a typed backend client object with methods for analytics, alerts, and transactions, or null if the API base URL is not configured.
